connector.name: Delx Memory
connector.registryDescription: Local-first persistent memory MCP: shared SQLite key/value store, searchable, TTL-aware, secret-safe
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package delx-memory. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the davidmosiah account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: DELX_MEMORY_PATH
env.description: Optional path to the SQLite store. Defaults to ~/.delx-memory/db.sqlite.

env.name: DELX_MEMORY_HOST
env.description: HTTP host when transport=http. Defaults to 127.0.0.1.

env.name: DELX_MEMORY_PORT
env.description: HTTP port when transport=http. Defaults to 3030.

env.name: DELX_MEMORY_ALLOWED_ORIGIN
env.description: CORS allow-origin when transport=http. Defaults to http://HOST:PORT.
